items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 July 2026 4:38pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 02 July 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the North Sea tracks eastwards, as high pressure to the southwest of Ireland builds a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

Mainly west or northwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5 in places at first, backing west or southwest tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate in places at first.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, imminently increasing 4 or 5, then veering west or southwest overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate in places.


##Weather##

Rain for a time, then mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in rain.
